title: Among female patients with abnormal platelet counts (either ≤100 or ≥400),
question: Among female patients with abnormal platelet counts (either ≤100 or ≥400), identify those who also have anti-scl70 within the normal range. For these patients, compute their age at the time of the laboratory test and return their diagnosis, albumin level, and a flag indicating whether their albumin is within the normal clinical range (3.5–5.5). Additionally, include only those whose laboratory test occurred after their first hospital visit.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  E."XCL_008" AS diagnosis,
  L."XCL_031" AS albumin,
  CASE WHEN L."XCL_031" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS albumin_normal
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (L."XCL_027" <= 100 OR L."XCL_027" >= 400)
  AND L."XCL_051" IN ('0', 'negative')
  AND L."XCL_015" > P."XCL_062"

Additionally, include only those whose laboratory test occurred after their first hospital visit.

SELECT
  E."XCL_008" AS diagnosis,
  L."XCL_031" AS albumin,
  CASE WHEN L."XCL_031" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS albumin_normal
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (L."XCL_027" <= 100 OR L."XCL_027" >= 400)
  AND L."XCL_051" IN ('0', 'negative')
  AND L."XCL_015" > P."XCL_062"

Laboratory.XCL_027 is identified as Platelet Count (PLT) with values ranging 70-665; question specifies abnormal platelet counts (≤100 or ≥400).
Laboratory.XCL_051 is identified as Anti-Scl70 with qualitative values '0', 'negative', '1', '2'; 'normal' corresponds to '0' or 'negative'.
Laboratory.XCL_015 is the lab test date; Patient.XCL_062 is the first visit/admission date. Question requires lab test to occur after first hospital visit.
Examination.XCL_008 contains diagnosis text values like 'SLE', 'PSS', 'MCTD'; question asks to return diagnosis.
Laboratory.XCL_031 is identified as Albumin (ALB) with values 2.6-6.6; question asks to return albumin level.
Question asks for a flag indicating whether albumin is within normal clinical range (3.5-5.5); computed via CASE WHEN on Laboratory.XCL_031.
